title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Limits on the Number of Boxes One Customer May Hold
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank lets a single customer lease more than one of its Safe Deposit Boxes. The number is bounded, however, and the bounds are judged across the customer's whole set of box rentals rather than box by box.

## Governing clause

A new reservation is recorded for a customer only while each of the following holds, measured from the bank's rental records for that customer on the current date:

1. **Overall ceiling.** The customer's open rentals, meaning every rental of any size whose status is waitlisted, active, past due or drill pending, number fewer than 3.
2. **Size ceiling.** The customer's open rentals of the size being requested number fewer than the per-size ceiling in the table below. Reservations still on the waitlist count toward this ceiling alongside leased boxes.
3. **Waitlist ceiling.** The customer's rentals in waitlisted status alone number fewer than the reservation limit in the table below.
4. **No box awaiting drilling.** None of the customer's rentals is in drill pending status. A single such rental is enough to bar a further reservation, whatever the counts above show.

Closed rentals, whether a surrendered lease, a drilled box or a reservation that ended without a lease, are not open and do not enter any count. The customer's own account of how many boxes they hold is not the measure; the rental records are.

## Ceilings by box size

| Box size | Existing open rentals of this size (reservations included) must be fewer than | Existing waitlisted reservations must be fewer than |
|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | 2 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | 2 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 | 2 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 |

Put another way, once a new reservation is added, a customer may have at most 2 open rentals of each of the three smallest sizes, at most 1 open rental of each of the three largest, no more than 3 open rentals across all sizes together, and no more than 2 reservations waiting at once.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical holdings)

| Hypothetical records on the current date | Size requested | Result |
|---|---|---|
| One active 3x5, one past due 5x10 | 3x10 | Limits met: 2 open overall, none of that size, no reservations waiting, nothing drill pending |
| Two active boxes and one waitlisted reservation | Any size | Not recorded: 3 open overall is not fewer than 3 |
| One active 10x10, one closed 3x5 | 10x10 | Not recorded: 1 open 10x10 already meets the ceiling of 1 for that size |
| One active 3x5 plus a 3x5 on the waitlist | 3x5 | Not recorded: 2 open 3x5 rentals meet that size's ceiling |
| One drill pending 3x10, nothing else open | 5x10 | Not recorded: a rental awaiting drilling bars any new reservation |

## Points of judgement

- *Does a surrendered box still use up a place?* No. Once a rental is closed it drops out of every count.
- *Does a reservation that has not yet become a lease count?* Yes. Waitlisted rentals are open, so each one counts toward the overall ceiling, toward its size's ceiling and toward the waitlist ceiling.
- *Is meeting these ceilings enough on its own?* The clause is a set of limits: failing any one of them means the reservation is not recorded, but the clause does not say that meeting them is sufficient.
